clue.text: The club's taskmaster

definitions.meaning: in golf, a long-hitting wooden club used off the tee

explanation.definitionFit: The golf wood for tee shots carries this name, and a hard boss who pushes workers on is called one too.

clue.text: Direction of theologian concealing private conflict?

indicators.note: concealing means holding out of sight, so the theologian wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, stands for a theologian
own means private, personal
war is conflict

explanation.surface: Which way does a churchman go when hiding a personal battle?
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealing' has the theologian hold the other two pieces inside. DD, Doctor of Divinity, is the crossword's standard theologian.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading towards lower ground is a course or bearing, hence a direction.

clue.text: Provisional single covered by batting call

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is in

indicators.note: covered by means enclosed within, so one letter sits inside the others

parts.note: to call is to name, to term
I is one, a single

explanation.surface: A single scored on a tentative call between batsmen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covered by' puts the single inside the other pieces. In cricket the side batting is said to be 'in'; 'call' as a verb means name.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrangement that holds only until something permanent is settled is temporary, so provisional.

clue.text: Rare western moth turns out to be a burrower

indicators.note: turns out suggests letters turned over into a new arrangement

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for west or western

explanation.surface: A rare western moth proves to be a creature that digs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns out' rearranges RARE + W + MOTH.
explanation.definitionFit: This soil-dwelling worm tunnels underground, so it is a creature that digs.

clue.text: In a tice, thus abandoned this craft

parts.note: a trice is a moment, abbreviated MO

indicators.note: the word abandoned is read as going in, placed inside the pair of words before it

parts.note: thus means so
abandoned means quit, as in gave up

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a little craft in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' sets the word for abandoned inside the pieces for 'a trice' and 'thus'. The Mosquito was a famous wooden British aircraft of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The de Havilland Mosquito was a wartime aircraft, and an aircraft is a craft.

clue.text: Main occupation of one rating as less than able?

definitions.text: Main occupation of one rating as less than able?

parts.words: Main occupation of one rating as less than able?
parts.note: main is the sea; a naval rating graded below able seaman holds the junior rank in that service

explanation.surface: A job description for someone judged not fully capable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' is the sea and 'rating' a naval sailor below officer rank; in the Royal Navy the junior grade sits beneath able seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Navy grades a junior sailor below the able rank with this title.

clue.text: Game type makes us flinch

definitions.meaning: a small game bird shot for sport

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a small game bird and also means to shrink back in fear.

clue.text: Tire, in a curious way, of this selling

indicators.note: arranged in a curious way means the letters are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: Tiring of this kind of sales technique, oddly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curious way' rearranges TIRE + IN A. The answer completes the phrase for sending unrequested goods and demanding payment unless returned.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase for sending unsolicited goods and billing unless returned puts this word before selling.

clue.text: Study of light subjects when the leader is delayed

indicators.note: the leading letter of the word arrives later in it

parts.note: topics are subjects of discussion

explanation.surface: Light subjects are studied once the leader turns up late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader is delayed' moves the T of TOPICS back two places.
explanation.definitionFit: The branch of physics dealing with the behaviour of light carries this name.

clue.text: Cheeky youth plying the cat with fish

parts.note: one who plies the cat o' nine tails is a whipper
a snapper is a food fish

explanation.surface: An impudent youngster wields a lash at a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the cat' is the cat o' nine tails, a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: An impertinent young person is the classic sense of this insult.

clue.text: Turning-point for the catchment area

definitions.meaning: a moment that marks a decisive change
the high ground and drainage basin that sends rain into a river system

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a decisive dividing moment in history and the ridge or drainage region feeding rivers.

clue.text: Expert liable to take in retired journalist

indicators.note: to take in means to hold within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: apt, as in liable or inclined to do something

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the letters for journalist are read backwards

parts.note: ED is short for editor, the standard crossword journalist

explanation.surface: An expert is prone to absorb an old newspaperman who has stopped working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns ED back to front into DE, which 'take in' places inside the word for liable. ED (editor) is the usual crossword journalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone adept is highly skilled, so the adjective works as a synonym for expert.

clue.text: Monitor, possibly, for many withdrawn from tutelage

indicators.note: something withdrawn from a word is taken out of it

parts.note: wardship, guardianship of a minor
D is the Roman numeral 500, a crossword many

explanation.surface: Lots of pupils pulled out of guardianship, says a school monitor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Monitor' looks like a school prefect or a screen; here it is a class of shallow-draught armoured gunboat, hence 'possibly'. 'withdrawn from' removes D (many) from WARDSHIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A monitor was a type of low-lying armoured naval vessel, one example of a fighting ship.

clue.text: Like Mrs Malaprop's allegory — nothing to do with the ear

parts.note: nil means nothing
otic means relating to the ear

explanation.surface: A literary allegory muddled by Sheridan's character has nothing to do with hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Malaprop, from Sheridan's play The Rivals, famously says 'allegory on the banks of the Nile' for alligator; so her allegory is a creature of the Nile.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaprop's allegory is an alligator-type river reptile, and things belonging to the Nile region are described by this adjective.

clue.text: Capital outlay originally for a Veronese

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

indicators.note: originally points to the start, the first letter of outlay

explanation.surface: An initial capital outlay is made for a painting by Veronese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Veronese' looks like the painter; here it means a man from Verona, Shakespeare's lover in Romeo and Juliet.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare set his young lover's story in Verona, making him a citizen of that city.

clue.text: Recusant kicked out of old country

indicators.note: kicked out suggests letters being knocked about into a new order

explanation.surface: A Catholic refusing to attend church is expelled from the old homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kicked out' rearranges RECUSANT. A recusant was one who refused to attend Church of England services.
explanation.definitionFit: Etruria was the ancient land of central Italy, and the adjective describes anything belonging to it.

clue.text: Vessel is in sea, but tricky to bring under control

indicators.note: is in means placed inside, so the vessel sits within the other letters
tricky suggests the letters are tricked into a different order

parts.note: a jug is a vessel

explanation.surface: A boat at sea is hard to steer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tricky' rearranges the letters of 'sea but' into SUBATE; 'is in' puts the vessel inside. The surface boat, a sub, is a decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: To conquer or subdue is to force into submission, bringing under control.

clue.text: Treachery of a girl and two boys

parts.note: Bet is a girl's name, short for Elizabeth
Ray is a boy's name
Al is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A love triangle of one girl and two boys ends in treachery.
explanation.definitionFit: Disloyalty and treachery are synonyms for breaking faith.

clue.text: The aforesaid establishment

definitions.meaning: in legal deeds, the property or matters already mentioned
a building with its grounds, a place of business

explanation.definitionFit: In conveyancing the word means the matters stated earlier, and in everyday use a building and its land.

clue.text: Go berserk at a time of racketeering

indicators.note: a time of something puts that something first, so age follows ramp

parts.note: a ramp is a swindle or racket
an age is a time

explanation.surface: People go wild at a time of organised crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' puts the time after the racket: in a phrase like 'age of X', X is the thing named, so here it leads. 'Ramp' is British slang for a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: To charge about violently is to run wild, behaving berserk.

clue.text: Engine support — for spongy ground, that is

parts.note: a bog is wet spongy ground
i.e., short for id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A railway engine's support is laid on marshy ground, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: A bogie is the wheeled truck beneath a railway locomotive or carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pivoting wheeled undercarriage holds up a locomotive, so it is literally what supports the engine.

clue.text: Annual freak tide seen in Indian territory

indicators.note: seen in means located inside, so letters sit within the territory

parts.note: Goa is a state of India

indicators.note: freak suggests something unusual, an odd rearrangement

explanation.surface: A freak tide observed on the Indian coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freak' rearranges TIDE into DETI; 'seen in' puts it inside Goa, a former Portuguese territory on India's west coast. 'Annual' looks like a yearbook but is a garden plant.
explanation.definitionFit: This garden flower is grown each year from seed, so it is an annual plant.

clue.text: Mare comes first at race meeting — what a lucky thing

indicators.note: comes first points to the initial letter of mare

parts.note: Ascot is a famous English race meeting

explanation.surface: A mare wins at the races: what luck!
explanation.walkthrough: ASCOT is a racecourse near Windsor with a famous royal race meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A charm or creature kept to bring good fortune is a talisman, one thing deemed lucky.

clue.text: Missiles appearing briefly in a riot? No, gas

indicators.note: briefly means in its short colloquial form, cutting the word for missiles down

parts.note: ammunition is the missiles fired from weapons

indicators.note: a riot is disorder, so the letters of in a are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Were weapons used during a riot? No, it was gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' clips AMMUNITION to its slang short form; 'riot' scrambles the letters of 'in a'. The 'No' rejects the surface reading that the missiles are themselves in a riot.
explanation.definitionFit: This pungent compound of nitrogen and hydrogen is a colourless gas.

clue.text: Hot drink for an Abyssinian king

definitions.meaning: a mulled wine with hot water, sugar and spice
the title of the Ethiopian emperor

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a warm spiced wine punch and the Ethiopian royal title.

clue.text: A part, say, indicated below

definitions.meaning: said aloud, a part sounds like apart, meaning in pieces
..., the phrase a document uses for what follows

explanation.definitionFit: The word means in pieces, sounding like apart, and split as 'as under' it is the formal phrase for matters listed below.

clue.text: Party resounding at the end with noise

parts.note: a clan is a group or faction, a party

indicators.note: at the end points to the final letter of resounding

explanation.surface: A party goes on echoing late into the night with loud noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud metallic ringing sound is one kind of noise.

clue.text: Student leaves badinage to the rustics

indicators.note: leaves means goes away from, so a letter departs the word

parts.note: pleasantry, light joking talk
L, the learner plate, stands for a student

explanation.surface: A student abandons light banter to mix with country folk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes L out of PLEASANTRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Country people who work the land form a collective noun covering farming folk.

clue.text: Prize to be relied on after rate revision

indicators.note: after means the dependable word goes behind the reworked one
a revision reworks the word rate into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: sure means reliable, certain

explanation.surface: A reliable prize after the rate is reviewed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revision' rearranges the letters of 'rate' into TREA; 'after' places the word for reliable behind them.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to value something highly is to prize it.

clue.text: Fine points for a fatigue-party, perhaps

definitions.meaning: small particulars; the word is used collectively for minute particulars
in the army, a small group assigned to a duty such as fatigues

explanation.definitionFit: The word means minute particulars and also a squad of soldiers told off for a particular task.
